The '''Wooden Blade''' is a [[Weapons#Sword|sword weapon]] that can be obtained from the [[Adventurer's Guild]] for {{Price|250}} as soon as the Adventurer's Guild is unlocked. It is also a possible reward for the chest on floor 10 of [[the Mines]] if "remixed" mine rewards are selected in the [[Options|Advanced Options]] menu when starting a new game.

==History==
{{History|1.5|Level lowered from 2 to 1 and sell price lowered from {{Price|100}} to {{Price|50}}. Added as a possible reward on floor 10 in the remixed Mines.}}
